About the Role
Oliver James is partnering with a leading enterprise organization migrating its core legacy systems from Adabas (Mainframe) to PostgreSQL.

We are seeking a Data Functional Analyst to bridge the gap between legacy business logic and modern database architecture. Working directly alongside Data Engineers and DBAs, you will define data mappings and ensure a seamless, high-integrity migration.
Key Responsibilities
• Legacy Data Analysis & Mapping: Deep-dive into Mainframe data structures and define accurate functional target mappings to PostgreSQL relational schemaq.
• Technical & Functional Guidance: Act as the primary functional advisor for Data Engineers and DBAs, writing clear functional specifications to guide ETL/ELT pipeline development and schema design.
• Data Quality & Reconciliation: Design data validation strategies, define test scenarios, and execute cross-database reconciliation checks (Mainframe legacy vs. PostgreSQL) to guarantee 100% data integrity and consistency.
• Data Lineage & Documentation: Maintain comprehensive data dictionaries, mapping rulebooks, and lineage documentation throughout the migration lifecycle.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the functional point of contact for resolving legacy data ambiguities and translating complex business rules for the technical delivery team.
Requirements & Qualifications
• Functional Data Expertise: 3 years of experience as a Data Functional Analyst, Business Data Analyst, or Data Consultant on large-scale data transformation projects.
• Database & SQL Skills: Strong, mandatory expertise in PostgreSQL and advanced proficiency in SQL and relational data modelling concepts.
• Mainframe Experience: Solid functional understanding of Mainframe database environments (knowledge of Adabas is nice to have, but not mandatory).
• Migration Track Record: Hands-on experience working on complex legacy-to-relational data migration projects.
• Language Skills:
• Fluent English (written and spoken).
• Professional fluency in French and/or Dutch (essential for local team and business stakeholder collaboration).
• Communication & Mindset: Excellent analytical skills, rigorous attention to detail, and the ability to articulate complex functional rules clearly to technical teams.

Senior PowerBuilder Developer

Technical leadership and application modernisation

Brussels * Hybrid * 3 days on site per week

Contract options: permanent, fixed-term or freelance | Start: as soon as possible

About the role

Help shape the next chapter of a business-critical application. You will combine hands-on PowerBuilder development and production support with technical leadership, preparing an established client/server platform for a progressive transition to Java and Angular.

The role connects existing application knowledge with future development: understanding how the system works, making its business rules explicit and helping developers carry them into the new platform.

Your responsibilities

• Resolve complex PowerBuilder issues and share production maintenance duties, following agreed support and documentation practices.
• Analyse application components and dependencies, including PBLs, PowerScript, PFC, DataWindows and DataStores.
• Identify business rules, edge cases and redundant behaviour; separate functional requirements from interface logic and historical workarounds.
• Decouple business logic from GUI controls and database access, including embedded SQL, dynamic SQL and stored procedures.
• Work with analysts and business specialists to translate existing behaviour into clear functional and technical specifications.
• Collaborate with Java/Angular developers on REST API contracts and validate regression coverage through characterisation and Golden Master tests.
• Build shared technical documentation, mentor colleagues and use static analysis and AI-assisted tools to maintain traceability between code and specifications.

What you bring

• At least 5 years of hands-on PowerBuilder development, with strong expertise in the PowerBuilder 8-2022 / Appeon environment.
• Advanced PowerScript and PFC knowledge: events, functions, structures, transaction handling (SQLCA, COMMIT, ROLLBACK), complex DataWindows (Composite, Group, Nested), expressions (Describe, Modify, Evaluate) and DataStores.
• Strong relational database and SQL skills, including transactional SQL, PL/SQL stored procedures and query optimisation.
• Understanding of stateless REST APIs, microservices, Spring Boot, Angular and JSON DTOs. Practical Java/Spring Boot and/or Angular experience, or a strong aptitude and willingness to develop these skills.
• An analytical approach, clear documentation for non-PowerBuilder developers and confident communication with business stakeholders, management and technical teams.
• French or Dutch, together with professional fluency in English.
Why consider this role

A hands-on technical lead opportunity combining production continuity, knowledge sharing and modernisation. Contribute to team development while building on your PowerBuilder expertise and expanding your involvement in Java and Angular.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.As part of our growth (RAMP UP) of LEAP engines, we are looking for a CNC Operator to strengthen our teams.

As experienced CNC machine operator, you will oversee our computer numeric controlled (CNC) machines. You will be responsible for ensuring machining of subassembly, quality parts and tools specific to engineering drawings dimensions.Your Role :

• Set up and operate CNC machines to perform various tasks, including drilling, grinding, and milling.
• Ensure CNC machines operate in compliance with company guidelines and safety standards.
• Monitor machines during operation and make necessary adjustments to optimize results.
• Inspect machinery daily to ensure proper functionality.
• Record all machine activities by completing production and quality logs.
• Provide accurate timelines and updates to clients.
• Communicate with the Methods Department regarding any issues encountered during machining.
• Ensure that machining results meet the defined work scope and quality expectations.
• Conduct regular assessments and maintenance of CNC machines.

Your Profile:

• High school diploma or equivalent qualification required.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a CNC machine operator.
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical documents and engineering drawings.
• Strong mechanical aptitude.
• Excellent attention to detail and a goal-oriented attitude.
• Strong comprehension and analytical skills.
• Knowledge of the latest equipment and techniques in the industry.
• Good computer skills.
• You have a very knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• Willingness to work in a 3-shift system
 

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

For an international, technology-driven company, we are looking for a Finance Analyst. In this role, you will combine financial analysis with in-depth cost analysis and project controlling. You will monitor the financial performance of international projects, analyse costs and profitability, and translate financial data into actionable insights for project management and senior management.  Finance Analyst - Responsibilities: 

• Financial analysis & project controlling: Analyse the financial performance of projects, monitor revenue, margins and profitability, and prepare forecasts and financial reports.
• Cost analysis & budget monitoring: Analyse project costs, resource allocation and budget variances. Investigate the drivers behind differences between budget, forecast and actual results, and recommend improvement actions.
• Forecasting & financial modelling: Prepare financial forecasts, estimate total project costs and expected results, and support complex financial analyses.
• Reporting & management information: Translate financial data into clear reports, variance analyses and presentations to support project managers and senior management in their decision-making.
• Risk & contract analysis: Identify financial risks and opportunities and assess the impact of contract changes on project costs, revenue and profitability.
• Financial project monitoring: Monitor budgets, funding and invoicing status, and collaborate with project management, finance, accounting and procurement to resolve financial matters.
• Financial accuracy & compliance: Ensure accurate financial processing and reporting in accordance with IFRS, internal controls and applicable company procedures.

Finance Analyst - Profile:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Accountancy, Business Management or a related field, or have equivalent relevant experience.
• You have 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in finance.
• You have a strong affinity for financial analysis, cost analysis, budget monitoring and profitability calculations. You are able to investigate financial variances and translate them into actionable insights.
• You have advanced Excel skills and are comfortable analysing and structuring large volumes of financial data and developing financial models.
• You have a solid understanding of accounting principles and revenue recognition. Experience with percentage-of-completion revenue recognition is considered an asset.
• You communicate effectively with a variety of stakeholders, including project managers and senior management, and can present financial information in a clear and structured manner.
• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus.
• Knowledge of SAP, different contract types or government contracts is an asset.

jobs.occupation: Contracts IT - Domain Delivery Lead, Public Sector Digital Transformation
jobs.description:
Location: Brussels, Belgium (hybrid, 2 days per week on site)

Contract: Freelance, 1 to 2 years

Start: As soon as possible

Languages: Native Dutch or French, plus good English
The opportunity

Our client, a Belgian federal public administration, is running a major digital transformation programme to modernise its business applications, strengthen collaboration between teams and build a more integrated, agile IT landscape. The programme is organised into domains, each led by a Domain Delivery Lead who brings several agile squads together around one vision.

We are recruiting three Domain Delivery Leads, each owning one domain of the programme

• Platform & Integration: the cross-domain technical backbone: integration, releases, Azure cloud, DevOps, security and data migration.

• Public Sector Transformation: a high-profile, politically sensitive public service domain.

• Digital Public Services: a domain delivering strategic applications behind core public services.

All three are senior delivery and programme management roles. You lead through influence, clarity of vision and trust rather than control. You will not be writing code or building infrastructure; you make it possible for several agile teams to deliver.
What you will do

• Unite several agile squads around a shared vision and keep business and team priorities aligned

• Create the conditions for autonomy and coach teams towards maturity (servant leadership)

• Build the overall plan with the teams, manage cross-team dependencies and arbitrate priorities transparently

• Run domain rituals: cross-team syncs, reviews and retrospectives

• Remove blockers by connecting the teams with the business, IT and other domains

• Manage change requests, report progress and risks to governance bodies and escalate in good time

• Manage suppliers as partners and own the domain budget

What the client is really looking for

• A builder, not a caretaker: someone who likes to create, evolve and unite teams, brings fresh ideas and challenges existing practices.

• A servant leader: you lead through trust, remove obstacles and help squads grow in autonomy.

• A strong business to IT translator: you explain complex IT in simple business language and turn policy and business needs into a clear roadmap.

• Proven at scale in the public sector: multiple squads, budgets and capacity on large digital transformations, ideally in government.

How you work

You influence without hierarchical authority, adapt your message to every audience, handle conflict diplomatically and stay calm and solution-focused under pressure.

Please send your CV or call elif and yasin to discuss further.

We are an equal opportunities employment agency and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or age.

We champion differences in technology recruitment and work with clients who actively wish to diversify their talent force - all applicants are welcome to apply

• 10+ years in a similar role, coordinating and steering multiple teams

• 5+ years of Agile delivery in complex IT environments

• 10+ years of project experience with complex stakeholder management on digitalisation projects

• 10+ years of project team leadership

• A business to IT bridge background, such as senior Product Owner, Business Relationship Manager or Programme Director

• Leading large multidisciplinary teams split across several squads

• Budget and capacity management within public budget envelopes

• Strong project management, governance and delivery practices

• Business process reengineering and change management in digital transformations

• Understanding of application lifecycle management

• Public sector experience

• Native Dutch or French speaker with good English

 

Additional must haves: platform & integration:

• Solution architecture and integration: critical path, API, messaging and batch patterns, interface contracts, versioning, reference data and workflow engines (for example Camunda)

• Release and environment management: Dtap, cross-team releases, cutover and rollback planning, end-to-end test strategy

• Azure: Landing Zone concepts, Entra ID, RBAC, PIM, Kubernetes, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code and FinOps basics

• Advanced Azure DevOps (work item hierarchies, Delivery Plans, dependencies, reporting), CI/CD and branching strategies

• Security and compliance: NIS2, GDPR for sensitive personal data, RPO/RTO, retention, logging and formal risk acceptance

• Data and migration: CDC and ETL flows to a data platform, running data migration as its own workstream

• Scrum and ITIL certifications

 

Additional must haves: public sector transformation:

• Proven project management inside a public administration or public body, leading complex projects or digital transformation

• Understanding of institutional dynamics and managing conflicting priorities in a politically sensitive environment, while staying neutral

 

Nice to have

Platform & Integration only. The other two roles have no nice-to-haves; candidates are assessed on the must-haves.

• Large-scale European IT systems

• Observability

• Enterprise architecture frameworks

• Basic KQL or OData for tracking and reporting

• Microsoft Azure certification

• At least 3 years of experience in a comparable customer service or order management role within an international sales organisation. Experience in medical devices or life sciences is a clear advantage

• Fluent English and Spanish, spoken and written. Dutch or other European languages are a plus

• Solid knowledge of the order process, and hands-on experience with an ERP system (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics AX)

• Good command of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Strong telephone skills and a real talent for listening

• An analytical and organised way of working, with careful documentation

• The ability to juggle several tasks, stay calm in a fast-changing environment and handle conflicts constructively

• Good interpersonal skills and the confidence to make an impact

Nice to haves

• Experience with Salesforce CRM

• Knowledge of how to use artificial intelligence in your daily work
